title: Citing Technical Reports & Impacts
goal: Attribute environmental findings formally with advertir/señalar/concluir que, de acuerdo con and según + verb.

items: I can attribute technical findings using *advertir*, *señalar*, *concluir* and *informar de que*.
I can use *de acuerdo con* + source and *según* + verb without inserting *que*.
I can discuss desertification, ecosystems, global warming, forest fires, water scarcity and ecological footprints.
